Read only the section needed for the current UDT.

Replace the container placeholder with a pinned BioContainer found through one
bounded live BioContainers lookup. Use a bare tagged reference without
`docker://` or a digest.

class: GalaxyUserTool
id: analysis-v1

version: 0.1.0
container: quay.io/biocontainers/<package>:<pinned-tag>

shell_command: |
  set -eu
  selected-command \
    --input "$(inputs.input.path)" \
    --output result.tsv

inputs:
  - name: input
    type: data
    format: [tabular]

outputs:

    type: data
    format: tabular

import os, zipfile, tempfile

api_key = open(os.environ.get('GALAXY_API_KEY_FILE', '')).read().strip()
import bioblend.galaxy
gi = bioblend.galaxy.GalaxyInstance(url='https://usegalaxy.org', key=api_key)

history_id = 'bbd44e69cb8906b547772a78169a2d18'
dataset_id = 'f9cad7b01a472135c14fd448f4d7b655'

# Download the ZIP
with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix='.zip', delete=False) as tmp:
    tmp_path = tmp.name

gi.datasets.download_dataset(dataset_id, file_path=tmp_path, use_default_filename=False)
print(f'Downloaded to: {tmp_path}')

# Extract specific file
target = '156083at2759.faa.mafft.clipkit.treefile'
with zipfile.ZipFile(tmp_path, 'r') as zf:
    names = [n for n in zf.namelist() if target in n]
    print(f'Matching files: {names}')
    if names:
        zf.extract(names[0], '/workspace/')
        print(f'Extracted: {names[0]} -> /workspace/{names[0]}')

os.unlink(tmp_path)
"
